title: Suggested build
description: A worked plan for reaching one style of play from creation to level 30 (docs/modules/builds/README.md). A suggestion: it gates nothing, and every perk it names is an ordinary feature row.

description.description: The style of play, in a sentence or two.

sub_path.description: The style inside the path; a hybrid names its two paths in its page.

attributes.description: The point buy of character creation step 2: 4 in every attribute plus 10 points, none over 10, before race modifiers and creation perks.

creation_perks.description: Level 1: up to two creation perks (features with type creation).

suggested_tag_skills.description: The tag skills: three, or four with a creation perk that adds one.

skill_priorities.description: Where the skill points go, in order: each entry raises its skill to `to` before the next gets a point. A skill may come back later with a higher value.

perks_by_level.description: The perk to take at each level that grants one, keyed by the level (2 to 30). A perk with ranks appears once per rank.
